tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: exactly FOUR full-body poses in a strict 2 by 2 row-major grid of the exact New England Cottontail adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the lightly anthropomorphic upright short-legged mascot and original arm-like forelimbs; do not revert to a natural quadruped. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 GREET: A connected existing forelimb/wing/fin gently raised in a small friendly greeting, same supported or floating body stance. 2 PRESENT_LEFT: Indicate viewer LEFT with gaze and a connected existing forelimb/wing/fin; clearly leftward teaching gesture, both feet supported where present. 3 PRESENT_RIGHT: Indicate viewer RIGHT with gaze and a connected existing forelimb/wing/fin; clearly rightward teaching gesture, preserve asymmetric markings, no mirrored copy. 4 THINK: Curious pondering small head tilt, existing forelimb close to chin where this anatomy permits; otherwise a small head/bill down tilt with natural resting wing/fin. Species constraints: ウサギの長い耳と小型ネズミ類の丸い耳を混同しない。小さい耳を長耳へ変えず、尾の有無と長さも維持する。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states. CRITICAL: Every pixel outside the subject silhouette must be genuinely fully transparent. No pale cloud, glow, paper backdrop, smoky halo, ambient colour, matte rectangle, cast shadow, floor or loose pigment outside its contour. Keep texture inside the subject only. Clear viewer-left and viewer-right gesture directions. Retain its rounded animal paws without a human thumb, index finger, fist or extra digit.
